title: Rabbi Bezirah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5, where Rabbi Levi speaks in his name. Hyman calls this a scribal error and proposes “in the name of Rabbi Nezirah,” as in the Amsterdam printing, and so the statement is cited in Bereshit Rabbah 12:6 and the end of chapter 82: “Rabbi Levi in the name of Rabbi Nezira.”

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5 has Rabbi Levi reporting Rabbi Nezirah; the Midrash Rabbah — TE Bereshit Rabbah 12:6 has Nezira. These support the proposed name form but do not prove the printed history Hyman reports for the Amsterdam edition.
Bereshit Rabbah 82 also has Levi reporting Nezira in the teaching on the first light. The Amsterdam reading is Hyman’s report.
